faqs.q: How long are my reward points valid?
faqs.a: HDFC Regalia Gold reward points are valid for 2 years from the date of accrual.

faqs.q: How can I avail the complimentary memberships?
faqs.a: Once you pay the joining fee and meet other eligibility requirements, you can claim the complimentary memberships through SmartBuy (for Regalia Gold).

faqs.q: Are there any restrictions on redeeming points for flights or hotels?
faqs.a: Points can be redeemed for flights and hotel bookings through SmartBuy, but they must be redeemed for bookings within India and with participating airlines and hotel chains. HDFC Bank regularly updates the list of partner airlines and hotels, hence consumers must check beforehand.

faqs.q: What happens if I do not meet the spend requirements for milestone benefits?
faqs.a: If you do not meet the spend requirements for milestone benefits (like vouchers or fee waiver), you will not be eligible for those specific benefits, but you will still earn reward points on regular spending.

faqs.q: Does HDFC Bank provide lounge access to add-on cardholders on the Regalia Gold Credit Card?
faqs.a: Add-on cardholders of HDFC Regalia Gold Credit Card can get their own Priority Pass by calling the HDFC Bank phone banking numbers 1800 1600 or 1800 2600 (toll-free) and avail complimentary airport lounge access using it.

faqs.q: What is the limit for HDFC Regalia Gold credit card?
faqs.a: The credit limit you get with your HDFC Regalia Credit Card depends on your income, current debts, maximum limit on your existing credit cards, and several other factors. You will get to know the limit offered to you only after you receive your credit card.

faqs.question: Is HDFC Regalia Gold worth it in 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you travel a few times a year and book through SmartBuy. The fee is waived at ₹4 lakh annual spend, and you get lounge access, milestone vouchers and a 1.25% base return at SmartBuy value.

faqs.question: Does Regalia Gold have lounge access?
faqs.answer: Yes. You get 3 domestic lounge visits per calendar quarter if you spent ₹60,000 or more in the previous quarter, and 6 international Priority Pass visits a year with no spend condition.

faqs.question: What is the annual fee of Regalia Gold?
faqs.answer: The joining and renewal fee is ₹2,500 + GST (₹2,950). It is waived if you spend ₹4 lakh in a year.

faqs.question: What is the reward rate of Regalia Gold?
faqs.answer: The card earns 5 reward points per ₹200 on retail spends, which is a 1.25% return at ₹0.50 per point. Select partner brands earn 5X and SmartBuy hotels earn 10X.
